answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by rewarding novelty over headcount. The ledger keeps a stylistic fingerprint of every answer an account submits across epochs. When two accounts behave like a mirror of each other — the same phrasing, the same errors blooming repeatedly like one lotus from a single pond — a clustering oracle merges their influence into one capped seat. An honest voice stands alone like a cedar; a swarm of reflections collapses to that single trunk, so spinning up clones earns no extra weight.
